en.headline: 14 own commits plus 12 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **14 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, plus 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 12 commits added Hunyuan 4 pelican-riding evaluation results and four-version comparisons, archived the evaluation artifacts and prompt text, and clarified that `AGENTS.md` is the single agreed location for agent guidance. Further commits removed conversational self-reflection and first-person wording from knowledge documents, corrected the LSP description using the official migration guide and the `experimental.todo` switch for `todowrite`, and added source evidence that LSP runtime support is not implemented while noting `browser` is a namespace. The remaining sandbox work ignored the `.workbuddy` data directory, rewrote the built-in tool list from the V1/V2 documents, updated the directory index with criteria for `enhance-prompt`, and recorded the desktop harness list with OpenCode V2 comment and tool comparisons. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 commits upgraded the gallery into a GitHub Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, discussions, replies, or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交，另有 12 次自动提交，分布于三个仓库
zh.summary: **14 次本人提交**分布在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 与 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`，另有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 12 次提交新增混元 4 版鹈鹕骑车实测与四版对比，归档评测产物并登记提示词原文，同时明确 `AGENTS.md` 为约定唯一落点。其余提交去除知识文档中的对话式自省与第一人称表述，按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径并补充 `todowrite` 的 `experimental.todo` 开关，还补入 LSP 运行时未实现的源码证据并说明 `browser` 是命名空间。后续工作还忽略 `.workbuddy` 数据目录，按 V1/V2 双文档重写内置工具清单，更新目录索引并补充 `enhance-prompt` 的形态判据，收录桌面 harness 清单与 OpenCode V2 评论和工具对照。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次提交将画廊升级为 GitHub Pages 首页，提供双语、明暗主题与复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面和可浏览的画廊页面。当天没有拉取请求、issue、评审、发布、讨论、回复或状态变更记录。
